# Alex Walker

> Managing Director of Havas Market UK, a 150-person performance marketing and commerce agency within Havas Media Network.

## About

Alex Walker is Managing Director of Havas Market UK, part of Havas Media Network — named Performance Marketing Agency of the Year by PMW and Silver at Campaign's UK Agency of the Year Awards. Havas Media Network UK won Leadership Team of The Year 2025 at The Media Leader Awards. He leads a team spanning paid search, SEO, retail media, social commerce, marketplaces, and data and analytics.

Alex founded Expert Edge in 2016, building it into a leading e-commerce consultancy before its acquisition by Havas Group in 2022. Prior to that he was a Senior Product Manager at Amazon UK and COO at WeFarm. He began his career founding Indigo Clothing — a custom printing and promotional merchandise business — while an undergraduate at the University of Cambridge.

He holds an MBA from HEC Paris and serves on the IAB UK Retail Media Working Group. A big-picture thinker comfortable with complexity and ambiguity, he reads structural shifts early and is willing to challenge accepted thinking when he sees a better way — the instinct behind his early commentary on the move from SEO to Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and the impact of AI on how people search, discover and buy.

## Expertise

- Retail Media
- Performance Marketing
- Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)
- Amazon Advertising
- E-commerce Strategy
- Social Commerce
- AI in Marketing
- Marketplaces
- Paid Search
- Data & Analytics

## Approach

- Big-picture strategist — works at the level of patterns and structural shifts, and is most effective with complex, ambiguous problems that lack a settled playbook.
- Rigorous and decisive — pairs a wide-angle view with an objective, rational read of the facts, and makes the call when one is needed.
- Challenges convention — willing to make the case for a better way, which is why he tends to be early to market-reshaping shifts like retail media and GEO.

## Key Positions

- The shift from SEO to Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) is the defining transition in digital marketing — and it's an opportunity, not a threat.
- Retail media must be treated as a strategic channel, not a checkbox on a media plan.
- Social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop are becoming genuine commerce channels for mainstream and FMCG brands.
- AI is fundamentally reshaping how consumers discover and choose products, and brands that adapt their content strategy will win.
